name: CreateSkill

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the skill. Only letters, digits, underscores, and hyphens are supported. The length cannot exceed 64 characters
parameters.help_zh: Skill 唯一标识。仅支持英文字母、数字、下划线或连字符，长度不超过 64 个字符
parameters.name: name

parameters.example: A Skill for reviewing code quality, security risks, and coding standards.
parameters.name: description

parameters.example: {"skillMd":"# Code Review\n检查代码质量、安全风险和编码规范。"}
parameters.help_en: The metadata of the skill, in JSON object format. One and only one content source must be provided. For specific fields, refer to the supplementary description of request parameters
parameters.help_zh: Skill 元数据，格式为 JSON 对象。必须且只能提供一种内容来源，具体字段参见“请求参数补充说明”
parameters.name: metadata

parameters.help_en: The visibility of the skill. Valid values: `user` and `tenant`. Default value: `user`
parameters.help_zh: Skill 可见性。可选值为 `user` 和 `tenant`，默认值为 `user`
parameters.name: visibility

Name.description_en: The unique identifier of the skill

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is used to locate and troubleshoot the request
RequestId.description_zh: 请求 ID，用于定位和排查本次请求

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the operation is successful. true is returned when the skill and its body or bundle are fully created and readable. Business failures are returned in error responses
Success.description_zh: Skill 及其正文或 Bundle 已完整创建并可读时返回 true。业务失败走错误响应

UpdatedAt.description_en: The update time after the skill is created. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
UpdatedAt.description_zh: Skill 创建完成后的更新时间，Unix 毫秒时间戳
